method: Native in-app browser screenshots; each encoded WebP on white, black, and the current grass-main-a. Ruts additionally viewed as three vertical repeats and a 100% boundary close-up. Human-model visual review, not runtime or device/FPS acceptance.

assets.name: wheat-ground
assets.note: Pass: golden stubble/soil rows run vertically; irregular alpha perimeter, no white/black matte or separate cast-shadow patch.

assets.name: wheat-card-a
assets.note: Pass alpha/silhouette: intact ears and stems, no base/shadow. Visible stem pivot measured. View reads fairly frontal; exact 52-degree elevation is not verified from the raster.

assets.name: wheat-card-b
assets.note: Pass alpha/silhouette: intact ears and stems, no base/shadow. Visible base is 11 pixels above the bottom because faint original fringe was preserved. View reads fairly frontal; exact elevation is not verified.

assets.name: wheat-card-c
assets.note: Pass alpha/silhouette: intact ears and stems, no base/shadow. Visible stem pivot measured. View reads fairly frontal; exact elevation is not verified.

assets.name: bed-soil-a
assets.note: Pass: horizontal dark-earth furrows, no vegetation/frame, clean irregular alpha perimeter on all three backgrounds.

assets.name: bed-soil-b
assets.note: Pass: horizontal dark-earth furrows, distinct clods and spacing, no vegetation/frame, clean irregular alpha perimeter.

assets.name: ruts-strip
assets.note: Conditional: two lighter tractor tracks, alpha sides and no faded end caps. Three repeats show no empty horizontal gap at 25%, but the 100% join has a small change of edge contour and tread/soil detail. Not verified seamless; no seam editing or extra generation.
